cases.title: Load Baseline

input.request: Measure a data pipeline at a defined workload.

cases.expected_output: Throughput, latency distribution, resource use, and data quality are measured on a fixed workload.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Throughput, latency distribution, resource use, and data quality are measured on a fixed workload.
Verification requirement: workload and environment recorded

cases.title: Data Integrity

input.request: Move data between services and verify the result.

cases.expected_output: Counts, keys, nullability, and checksums reconcile; rejected records are accounted for.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Counts, keys, nullability, and checksums reconcile; rejected records are accounted for.
Verification requirement: error bucket totals match input

cases.title: Capacity

input.request: Estimate capacity under a forecasted growth scenario.

cases.expected_output: Assumptions, safety margin, bottleneck, and scaling trigger are explicit and testable.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Assumptions, safety margin, bottleneck, and scaling trigger are explicit and testable.
Verification requirement: load-test limit or extrapolation stated
